32099-the-titanic-disaster-poem.title: The Titanic Disaster Poem
32099-the-titanic-disaster-poem.creator: Unknown
32099-the-titanic-disaster-poem.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Outstretched hands offered reward  For his brave and heroic deed  But the intrepid man went down aboard  Trying to rescue a passenger instead  This ill-starred giant of the sea  Was carried to his grave  On the last and greatest ship, was he,  That ever cleft a wave.

76668-trial-by-water.title: Trial By Water
76668-trial-by-water.creator: Unknown
76668-trial-by-water.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. jests and subtle flatterings. Jean Baptiste was small, for all his strength, and dark and grave. He spoke softly and infrequently, and his adoration for Charlotte was in his heart and in his eyes, not upon his tongue.

arxiv-2101-04574.title: Superpixel-based Refinement for Object Proposal Generation
arxiv-2101-04574.creator: Christian Wilms, Simone Frintrop
arxiv-2101-04574.description: Abstract Precise segmentation of objects is an important problem in tasks like class-agnostic object proposal generation or instance segmentation. Deep learning-based systems usually generate segmentations of objects based on coarse feature maps, due to the inherent downsampling in CNNs. This leads to segmentation boundaries not adhering well to the object boundaries in the image.

arxiv-2105-01784.title: Sampling Colorings and Independent Sets of Random Regular Bipartite Graphs in the Non-Uniqueness Region
arxiv-2105-01784.creator: Zongchen ChenAndreas GalanisDaniel Štefankovič, Eric Vigoda
arxiv-2105-01784.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zongchen ChenAndreas GalanisDaniel Štefankovič, Eric Vigoda. For spin systems, such as the q q -colorings and independent-set models, approximating the partition function in the so-called non-uniqueness region, where the model exhibits long-range correlations, is typically computationally hard for bounded-degree graphs. We present new algorithmic results for approximating the partition function and sampling from the Gibbs distribution for spin systems in the non-uniqueness region on random regular bipartite graphs.

arxiv-2108-08445.title: Seven Principles for Rapid-Response Data Science: Lessons Learned from Covid-19 Forecasting
arxiv-2108-08445.creator: Bin Yu, Chandan Singh
arxiv-2108-08445.description: Abstract In this article, we take a step back to distill seven principles out of our experience in the spring of 2020, when our 12-person rapid-response team used skills of data science and beyond to help distribute 340,000+ units of Covid PPE.

arxiv-2112-13974.title: A Moment in the Sun: Solar Nowcasting from Multispectral Satellite Data using Self-Supervised Learning
arxiv-2112-13974.creator: Akansha Singh Bansal, Trapit Bansal, David Irwin
arxiv-2112-13974.description: Abstract Solar energy is now the cheapest form of electricity in history. Unfortunately, significantly increasing the grid’s fraction of solar energy remains challenging due to its variability, which makes balancing electricity’s supply and demand more difficult. While thermal generators’ ramp rate—the maximum rate that they can change their output—is finite, solar’s ramp rate is essentially infinite.

arxiv-2207-04500.title: FIB: A Method for Evaluation of Feature Impact Balance in Multi-Dimensional Data
arxiv-2207-04500.creator: Xavier F. Cadet, Sara Ahmadi-Abhari, Hamed Haddadi
arxiv-2207-04500.description: Abstract Errors might not have the same consequences depending on the task at hand. Nevertheless, there is limited research investigating the impact of imbalance in the contribution of different features in an error vector. Therefore, we propose the Feature Impact Balance (FIB) score. It measures whether there is a balanced impact of features in the discrepancies between two vectors.

arxiv-2210-05796.title: Accurate computations up to break-down of quasi-periodic attractors in the dissipative spin-orbit problem Thanks: R.C. acknowledges the hospitality of the Department of Mathematics at the University of Barcelona, where he had a María Zambrano Fellowship. R.C. was also partially supported by DGAPA-UN
arxiv-2210-05796.creator: Renato Calleja, Alessandra Celletti, Joan Gimeno, Rafael de la Llave
arxiv-2210-05796.description: Abstract . We consider a Celestial Mechanics model: the spin-orbit problem with a dissipative tidal torque, which is a singular perturbation of a conservative system. The goal of this paper is to show that it is possible to compute quasi-periodic attractors accurately and reliably for parameter values extremely close to the breakdown.

arxiv-2303-02864.title: The hidden sector variations in the 𝒩 = 1 {\cal N}=1 supersymmetric three-family Pati-Salam models from intersecting D6-branes
arxiv-2303-02864.creator: Adeel Mansha, Tianjun Li, Lina Wu
arxiv-2303-02864.description: Abstract It is well-known that three-family supersymmetric Pati-Salam models from intersecting D6-branes, where either one or both of the U ⁡ ( 2 ) {\rm U}(2) gauge factors are replaced by a USp ⁡ ( 2 ) {\rm USp}(2) group, are quite scarce.

arxiv-2306-11425.title: Cosmic Chronometers with Photometry: a new path to H ⁡ ( z ) H(z)
arxiv-2306-11425.creator: Benjamin D. Wandelt
arxiv-2306-11425.description: Abstract We present a proof-of-principle determination of the Hubble parameter H ⁡ ( z ) H(z) from photometric data, obtaining a determination at an effective redshift of z = 0.75 z=0.75 ( 0.65 < z < 0.85 0.65<z<0.85 ) of H ⁡ ( 0.75 ) = 105.0 ± 7.

arxiv-2308-10460.title: Unified dark energy from Chiral-Quintom model with a mixed potential in Friedmann–Lemaître–Robertson–Walker cosmology
arxiv-2308-10460.creator: Andronikos Paliathanasis
arxiv-2308-10460.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Andronikos Paliathanasis. For a spatially Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker cosmology, we propose a multi-scalar field gravitational model. Specifically, we consider a two-scalar field cosmological model in which the kinetic components of the scalar fields establish a two-dimensional sphere of Lorentzian signature.

arxiv-2409-16622.title: Heralded optical entanglement distribution via lossy quantum channels: A comparative study
arxiv-2409-16622.creator: Wan Zo, 1,2 Seungbeom Chin, 3,4,* and Yong-Su Kim 1,5,†
arxiv-2409-16622.description: Abstract Quantum entanglement serves as a foundational resource for various quantum technologies. In optical systems, entanglement distribution rely on the indistinguishability and spatial overlap of photons. Heralded schemes play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability of entanglement generation by detecting ancillary photons to signal the creation of desired entangled states.

arxiv-2505-08022.title: Dynamical Low-Rank Compression of Neural Networks with Robustness under Adversarial Attacks
arxiv-2505-08022.creator: Steffen Schotthöfer, H. Lexie Yang, and Stefan Schnake
arxiv-2505-08022.description: Abstract Deployment of neural networks on resource-constrained devices demands models that are both compact and robust to adversarial inputs. However, compression and adversarial robustness often conflict. In this work, we introduce a dynamical low-rank training scheme enhanced with a novel spectral regularizer that controls the condition number of the low-rank core in each layer.

arxiv-2509-05483.title: Veriserum: A dual-plane fluoroscopic dataset with knee implant phantoms for deep learning in medical imaging
arxiv-2509-05483.creator: Jinhao Wang, Florian Vogl, Pascal Schütz, Saša Ćuković, William R. Taylor
arxiv-2509-05483.description: Abstract Veriserum is an open-source dataset designed to support the training of deep learning registration for dual-plane fluoroscopic analysis. It comprises approximately 110,000 X-ray images of 10 knee implant pair combinations (2 femur and 5 tibia implants) captured during 1,600 trials, incorporating poses associated with daily activities such as level gait and ramp descent.

pmc-10555603.creator: Delfina C Mazza Elizalde, Ricardo H Menendez, Maximiliano Di Fabio, Douglas Ruiz, Juan Manuel Eiroa, Catalina Vittar, German Arias, Horacio A Sole
pmc-10555603.description: BACKGROUNDComplete resection of an arteriovenous malformation (AVM) is considered a curative treatment. In this paper the authors discuss two possibilities in the event of hemorrhage after satisfactory resection of an AVM: recurrence or remnant.OBSERVATIONSA 33-year-old female patient was diagnosed with an incidental right frontal AVM that was microsurgically resected and whose postoperative angiography showed no remnant.

pmc-11620207.title: Quality characteristics and antioxidant activity of the Korean traditional rice-oat wine “Makgeolli” supplemented with green seaweed Codiumfragile

We analyzed its quality characteristics and antioxidant activity. The rice-based Makgeolli with Cf was designated as the control (CRM).

pmc-12689519.title: A machine learning algorithm to predict treatment effectiveness for Kawasaki disease in China: a retrospective model development and validation study
pmc-12689519.creator: Xuemei Li, Zihan Zhou, Jingyi Fan, Lin Zhao, Ruidi Xu, Dong Li, Xu Ma, Lu Sun, Yujian Wu, Zhouping Wang, Ce Wang
pmc-12689519.description: BackgroundKawasaki disease (KD) is the primary cause of acquired heart disease in children. Intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) is the first-line therapy for KD; however, IVIG resistance can occur. Reliable treatment efficacy prediction tools for Chinese patients are lacking, which this study aimed to address.

pmc-12820093.title: Hyper-spectral imaging with up-converted mid-infrared single-photons
pmc-12820093.creator: Yijian Meng, Asbjørn Arvad Jørgensen, Andreas Næsby Rasmussen, Lasse Høgstedt, Søren M M Friis, Mikael Lassen
pmc-12820093.description: Hyperspectral imaging in the mid-infrared (MIR) spectral range provides unique molecular specificity by probing fundamental vibrational modes of molecular bonds, making it highly valuable for biomedical and biochemical applications. However, conventional MIR imaging techniques often rely on high-intensity illumination that can induce photodamage in sensitive biological tissues.
